test_title: PYST 56: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 12 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct option to form a meaningful sentence.

I (a) / that (b) / the chef (c) / to work (d) / in (e) / the new (f) / heard (g) / restaurant (h) / is going (i) / across the road (j).

options.text: a, c, g, b, h, i, f, e, d, j
a, b, d, c, e, f, h, g, i, j
a, b, d, c, g, e, f, h, i, j
a, g, b, c, i, d, e, f, h, j

solution:
The correct answer is **Option (4)** 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with the subject "I," which is correctly indicated by **part (a).**** **
 
• Following the subject, "heard that the chef" **(a g b c)** continues the logical sequence, making it clear what was heard.
 
• **The next part,** "is going to work" starts the explanation about what the chef is going to do, indicated by (**i d**).
 
• **Ending with **"in the new restaurant across the road" (**e f h j**) completes the sentence by stating where the chef is going to work.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option (4).**

 

**Complete Sentence: ** I heard that the chef is going to work in the new restaurant across the road.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** This option starts with "I the chef heard that is going to work in the new restaurant across the road," which makes the sentence incorrect as the sequence is jumbled.
 
• **Option 2:** This option starts with "I that to work the chef is going in the new restaurant across the road," which makes the sentence incorrect as the sequence is jumbled.
 
• **Option 3:** This option starts with "I that to work the chef heard in the new restaurant is going across the road.," which makes the sentence incorrect as the sequence is jumbled.
